decisions.reason: As a renamed successor to an already well-liked trommel screen with clear public presentation, it has accumulated market acceptance and sunk commitment, so management would be very reluctant to withdraw it.

This multi-model mobile grinder line fits the firm's mobile processing direction and likely shares development and service resources with the core portfolio, encouraging management to persist and explain any uneven demand by project timing or market cycles.

The stationary electric fine shredder remains the most vulnerable because it appears less visibly committed and narrower than the larger lines, but its fit with resource-saving and tougher-processing objectives still makes continuation more likely than withdrawal.
The green-waste grinder line is a specialized but coherent extension of the firm's mobile machinery offering, so sunk development effort and portfolio logic would push management to keep backing it.

A dedicated page and several models signal substantial investment and strategic importance in stationary shredding, making management unlikely to reverse course after staying with the line for several years.
